    // True when `p` clears slot `c` of a grid row: an empty slot never blocks, and
    // an occupied one blocks only inside the radius.
    PoissonSlotFree(p: Point2D, region: Bounds2D, radius: Number,
        slots: Array<Point2D>, c: Integer): Boolean
        => IsEmptyCell(slots[c], region, radius) || slots[c].Distance(p) >= radius;
